title: cm API JWT claims
description: Public claims shape only. A maintained JWT verifier must separately validate the signature against configured trusted keys, exact issuer/audience, time, revocation and restore cutoff. Authorization uses exact action scopes.

iss.description: Must exactly match a configured trusted issuer; never selected by the token.

sub.description: Opaque principal identifier for attribution and command deduplication, never a permission grant.

jti.description: Unique credential identifier for revocation and audit.

client_id.description: Opaque placement identifier, not environmental attestation or authority.

scope.description: Space-delimited, case-sensitive action scope words. Empty or unknown words grant no action. No implicit grants or wildcard expansion.

campaign_id.description: Optional exact campaign restriction, applied uniformly to every action scope. If absent, scopes cover this API instance; no resource restriction is inferred from identity.
